$meta.$description: Klippin design tokens, exported from Figma "Klippin · Brand & UI Kit" (IGTHBBHnQKAUlVWOXWvFhz) on 2026-10-25. Dark only. Two systems: Clipper (default) and Client (modes.client, CSS scope [data-system="client"]), Client added 2026-10-27 from the live Client landing page. Figma variables are the source of truth; regenerate this file, do not edit it by hand.

orange-red.$description: Brand guide · Orange Red. THE brand colour.

coral-red.$description: Brand guide · Coral Red (highlight; logo accent end)

500.$description: Error red, hue kept away from brand orange

cornflower.$description: Brand guide · Cornflower Blue. Client brand colour.

cyan.$description: Brand guide · Bright Cyan. Glows only.

base.$description: Level 0: app screen background; alternating web sections.

surface-low.$description: Level 1 (web): quiet solid card on base-deep.

surface.$description: Level 1: cards, containers, sheets. Pair with border/default.

raised.$description: Level 3: overlays (popups, sheets, menus, dropdowns). Pair with border/default + elevation/overlay.

raised-strong.$description: Pressed state for secondary elements; strong fills inside overlays.

tint.$description: Level 2: elements on any surface (secondary buttons, icon buttons, chips, pills, tags, selects). Always one step lighter than beneath.

tint-strong.$description: Level 2 pressed / tinted elements inside overlays.

surface-glass.$description: Translucent card over imagery or glows. Pair with border/glass.

danger-soft.$description: Solid red tint for Danger soft buttons. Opaque so it looks the same on base, surface, raised and popups.

tertiary.$description: Meta: dates, categories, counts. ≥4.5:1 on all backgrounds.

on-primary-button.$description: WHITE. Only for labels on the primary button gradient (client preference). Semibold, 14px+.

on-orange.$description: DARK. Every other orange surface: PAID chip (gradient), count badges, eyebrows, leaderboard highlight row, balance amount.

primary.$description: Orange Red: primary action, active nav, emphasised money, solid brand fills.

primary-end.$description: Gradient end of the primary button gradient.

accent.$description: Coral Red: highlight; logo accent; gradient end in brand art. Not for errors.

primary-subtle.$description: Selected chip / tab tint, outgoing chat bubble.

gold.$description: Leaderboard place 1 medal disc. Dark content (text/on-orange) on top.

silver.$description: Leaderboard place 2 medal disc. Dark content (text/on-orange) on top.

bronze.$description: Leaderboard place 3 medal disc. Dark content (text/on-orange) on top.

pressed-overlay.$description: Black overlay on pressed primary button

hero.$description: Web only. Landing page hero headline.

stat.$description: Web stat figures and big money.

l.$description: App screen-level money and big numbers.

button.$description: Primary button L. White on gradient needs 18px semibold.

eyebrow.$description: Web eyebrows only. Agreed exception to Inter (original LP look).

brand-primary.$description: Primary buttons, PAID chip, progress fill. 120°.

apricot-to-orange.$description: Brand guide. Logo letters (hero moments, one per view).

orange-to-coral-red.$description: Brand guide. Logo accent triangle, app tile.

vibrant-orange.$description: Brand guide. Mono app tile; primary button web hover.

orange-to-near-black.$description: Brand guide. Hero glows and section fades on web.

brand-fade.$description: Featured containers: bg/surface with a soft orange fade.

brand-tint.$description: Leaderboard “you” row. Pair with 1px brand/primary border.

overlay.$description: Level 3 only: popups, sheets, menus, dropdowns, calendar. With bg/raised + border/default over bg/scrim.

icon-on-media.$description: White icons on thumbnails/photos. Use with a bottom fade.

client.$description: Client system. Same names as the default (Clipper) tokens; only listed tokens change. Shared: status, rank, spacing, radius scale, borders widths, layout, opacity, alphas, danger-soft. CSS scope: [data-system="client"].

surface-low.$description: Quiet card on the page body.

surface.$description: Cards, form panel. Pair with border/default.

raised-strong.$description: Pressed secondary; strong fills inside overlays.

on-primary-button.$description: Black, on the light White to Blue gradient.

on-orange.$description: Name kept for parity: dark text on any light brand fill.

brand.$description: Links, highlighted words in headings, active labels.

primary.$description: Cornflower: active nav, solid brand fills.

primary-end.$description: White: light end of the primary gradient.

accent.$description: Bright Sky Blue: metrics, focus ring, glow source. Not for errors.

cornflower-to-royal-blue.$description: Brand guide. Logo accent, app tile.

deep-navy.$description: Brand guide. Hero glows and section fades on web.

client/card-title.$description: Client only. Card and step titles.
